events.name: Bearly Dead - Trib. To The Grateful Dead
events.info: Bearly Dead -- A Tribute to The Grateful Dead is coming to Middle Ages Music Hall! A nationally touring Grateful Dead tribute, Bearly Dead brings a full-spectrum live show packed with danceable energy, world-class musicianship, spontaneous jams, and plenty of cosmic surprises. The band celebrates the full journey of the Grateful Dead, from the early records through the final tours, with unique takes on the hits, deep cuts, B-sides, and more. They also weave in classics from the jam, rock, and funk worlds, making every show a one-of-a-kind experience. Presented by Visions FCU
events.pleaseNote: Please be aware of the following age-related restrictions for this event: All Ages (Under 18 w/ Guardian).

events.name: Jurassic Quest – Syracuse, NY | New York State Fairgrounds
events.description:
The Ultimate Family Adventure Is Here!  

Jurassic Quest is bigger than ever, bringing together dinosaurs, prehistoric sea creatures, and Ice Age giants in one unforgettable experience.  

🦕 Jurassic Quest – Walk among life-sized, moving dinosaurs including the mighty T. rex, towering Apatosaurus, and massive Spinosaurus. Dig for fossils, meet adorable baby dinos, and ride your favorite prehistoric giants.  

🌊 Ancient Oceans – Dive beneath the surface and come face-to-face with incredible creatures that ruled the seas millions of years ago, including our jaw-dropping 53-foot Megalodon.  

❄️ Frozen Frontier – Step into the Ice Age and encounter legendary creatures like the Woolly Mammoth and Saber-Toothed Cat as you explore a world frozen in time.  

Plus enjoy interactive exhibits, hands-on activities, inflatables, rides, photo opportunities, and prehistoric fun for the whole family.  

🎟️ One ticket gets you access to all three incredible experiences. Don't miss North America's largest prehistoric adventure — get your tickets before they go extinct! 🦖✨

events.info: Gather your fellow witches, warlocks, and Halloween lovers, hop on your broom, and fly over for a movie experience that?s equal parts spooky and scrumptious! Watch the beloved Halloween classic Hocus Pocus while enjoying wickedly themed treats timed to magical moments throughout the film. From cauldron-worthy confections to hauntingly sweet surprises, every bite is designed to bring you deeper into the world of Max, Dani, Binx, and the delightfully devious Sanderson Sisters. When the spell is cast, you'll taste the magic too! Perfect for families, friend groups, and Halloween fanatics of all ages, this enchanting event transforms a favorite film into a fully immersive Taste-A-Long® adventure. Every ticket includes a premium Taste-A-Long® Candy Box ? a beautifully designed advent-style package filled with treats that correspond to moments throughout the film. Follow the on-screen cues and "taste along" in real time as the story unfolds.
